repos.name: anujasid/mcp-for-blender-pro
repos.description: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, model selection, multi-agent workflows. Works with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Ollama and OpenCode. Blender AI automation, bpy scripting, 3D modeling, geometry nodes and MCP integration.
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered assistant and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server designed to automate Blender workflows.
bullets: Built with Python, integrating with major LLM providers like OpenAI, Claude, and Ollama.
Implements MCP to bridge AI agents with Blender's bpy scripting environment.
Enables multi-agent workflows for complex 3D scene generation and automated visual chat.
Targeted at technical artists and developers looking to automate 3D asset production pipelines.
repos.img_alt: AI chat workspace with a live Blender scene preview

repos.name: Da7-Tech/SureForge
repos.description: Agent Skill for complex work: research before asking, ask before planning, plan before building, verify before delivering, independent review before calling it done. Plain text, no runtime.
repos.one_liner: An agentic framework focused on high-reliability task execution through structured reasoning and verification.
bullets: Python-based architecture emphasizing a 'research-plan-build-verify' lifecycle.
Designed for complex, multi-step work requiring independent review before final delivery.
Uses plain text configurations to maintain transparency and avoid opaque runtime dependencies.
Ideal for autonomous agents tasked with high-stakes coding or research assignments.

repos.name: jub0t/Concat
repos.description: Concat: The truly free, and open-source cross-platform CapCut replacement. Supports MCPs & API.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, open-source video editing engine written in Rust, designed as a CapCut alternative.
bullets: Developed in Rust for memory safety and high-speed video processing performance.
Features native support for MCP and external APIs, allowing for programmatic video manipulation.
Provides a cross-platform foundation for building automated video generation tools.
Useful for developers building AI-driven video editing or content automation platforms.

repos.name: Leonxlnx/earshot
repos.description: Ears for coding agents: let AI hear, review and make sound. CPU-only, open source.
repos.one_liner: An open-source audio processing layer that enables AI agents to 'hear' and interact with sound.
bullets: Python-based implementation optimized for CPU-only environments.
Provides a bridge for coding agents to review, analyze, and generate audio feedback.
Low-overhead design makes it suitable for integration into existing agentic workflows.
Enables multimodal agent capabilities, moving beyond text-only interaction.

repos.name: rohit267/net-merge
repos.description: Use all your network adapters at once on Windows: per-connection load balancing over Wi-Fi, Ethernet and phone/USB tethers (TUN + Wintun)
repos.one_liner: A network infrastructure tool for Windows that aggregates multiple internet connections into a single high-bandwidth stream.
bullets: Written in Go, utilizing TUN and Wintun drivers for low-level network packet management.
Performs per-connection load balancing across Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and mobile tethering.
Solves connectivity bottlenecks for data-intensive tasks like large model training or cloud syncing.
Essential infrastructure for developers working in remote or unstable network environments.
